issues.reason: Grounded modifies only Base Speed flight/encumbrance components. Component targeting and flight cooldown must be implemented; treating this as full replacement would erase land speed. Unresolved telepathy/sending/spell catalogs remain manual.
All five heritages encoded but the Goug Knowledge or-choice, replacement of baseline Keen Senses, and every vector need independent rule/UI review before auto application.
All current race-page rewards retained for manual use; canonical class-page cross-check and dependency resolution still required.
Moogle limited flight, extra CON-check rounds and cooldown, hydrophobia and situational bonuses must stay conditional/manual; do not auto-grant unconditional flight or global attack/skill modifiers.

Moogle Handy now binds one actual Craft/Profession row and specialty, and standard bonus languages have a bounded starting choice. Alternate Knowledge selections and Moogle Magic spell choices still require their own adapters; independent rule review remains pending.

features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 CHA and −2 STR racial adjustments.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with the moogle subtype.

features.name: Size
features.description: Small; size modifiers to AC, attack, CMB, CMD and Stealth belong to global size rules, not double-counted racial bonuses.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: Land speed 20 feet; limited wing-assisted flight at the same speed (clumsy) only in light/no armor and with light load. Fly CON-bonus rounds without checks; each extra round requires CON check DC 10 + 2 per extra round. Rest twice number of flown rounds before flying again. +4 Acrobatics when flight-capable.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Start Common and Moogle; bonus-language candidates Aklo, Auran, Banganese, Draconic, Goblin, Numish, Seeq, Sylvan.

features.name: Defensive Training
features.description: +4 dodge AC against giant-subtype monsters.

features.name: Eternal Hope
features.description: +2 racial saves vs fear and despair. Once per day after rolling a natural 1 on d20, reroll and use new result.

features.name: Emissary
features.description: Once daily, roll twice on one Bluff or Diplomacy check and keep higher result.

features.name: Good Merchant
features.description: +2 racial Appraise; +2 racial Diplomacy checks involving business transactions.

features.name: Handy
features.description: Choose one Craft or Profession skill specialization for +2 racial checks.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: +2 racial Perception checks.

features.name: Scavenger
features.description: +2 racial Appraise and Perception only when detecting concealed items (including traps or secret doors), testing food spoilage, or identifying a potion by taste.

features.name: Construct Familiarity
features.description: +1 racial attacks versus constructs; +4 dodge AC versus constructs.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: In dim light see twice as far as a hume.

features.name: Hydrophobia
features.description: When drenched by water or another liquid, −2 attack rolls and concentration checks.

condition.description: Character is drenched by water or other liquid

features.name: Academician
features.description: Choose one Knowledge specialty for +2 racial checks.

features.name: Attentive
features.description: +2 racial Sense Motive; +4 instead when detecting enchantment or possession.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Gain darkvision 60 feet.

features.name: Engineer
features.description: +2 racial Craft (alchemy) and Knowledge (engineering).

features.name: Explorer
features.description: +2 racial Climb and one chosen Knowledge specialization.

features.name: Gift of Tongues
features.description: +1 Bluff and Diplomacy; obtain one additional language every time you increase Linguistics rank.

features.name: Grounded
features.description: Lose limited flight. Retain 20-foot land speed without reduction from encumbrance or medium/heavy armor and similar effects; +1 racial saves against speed reduction. This modifies Base Speed only.

features.name: Knack with Poison
features.description: +2 racial Fortitude vs poison, increased to +4 if accidentally self-poisoned when handling or applying it; +2 Craft (alchemy) to make poisons.

features.name: Kupo-Recovery
features.description: When dying, an adjacent creature can spend a standard action providing kupo-nut taste to stabilize the moogle immediately.

features.name: Limited Telepathy
features.description: Mentally communicate with any known moogle within 1 mile; otherwise follow telepathy rules.

features.name: Low Blow
features.description: +1 bonus to confirm critical hits against larger creatures.

features.name: Master Tinker
features.description: +1 Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering); proficient with non-exotic weapons personally crafted.

features.name: Mognet
features.description: Once weekly send a message to another moogle with the effect of Sending.

features.name: Moogle Magic
features.description: With CHA 11+, each of dancing lights, detect magic, grab and ignite is usable 1/day as a spell-like ability. Caster level = character level; save DC = 10 + spell level + CHA modifier.

features.name: Outrider
features.description: +2 Handle Animal and Ride.

features.name: Shiftless
features.description: +2 racial Bluff and Sleight of Hand; Sleight of Hand becomes class skill.

features.name: Unfettered
features.description: +4 racial Escape Artist, +2 racial saves against entangled, CMD against grapple and maneuvers to escape grapple.

features.name: Wanderlust
features.description: +2 Knowledge (geography) and Survival; caster level treated as +1 for magic/abilities that improve movement.

features.name: Wright
features.description: +2 racial Drive and Craft/Repair checks made to build or fix vehicles.

features.description: Heritage ability adjustments: {'con': 2, 'cha': 2, 'wis': -2}. Apply instead of the standard racial ability adjustment, never in addition.

features.description: Gain +2 racial on Knowledge (nature) checks instead of the baseline +2 Perception trait.
